summary: Documentation and test-only change with no runtime behaviour change. It rewrites the JSDoc on EncryptionClient.decrypt / bulkDecrypt (native and wasm-inline entries), the table-less decryptModel overload and a runtime comment, to state that the raw decrypt paths do not reconstruct Date values and to correct the stated reason. It updates the shipped skills/stash-encryption/SKILL.md and the @cipherstash/stack README to match, adds runtime and type-level tests pinning the boundary, and fixes the stub casts in an existing unit test file. The only executable source lines touched are in tests; the delegations in client-v3.ts and the wasm decrypt bodies are unchanged. The shipped SKILL.md is bundled into the stash and @cipherstash/wizard tarballs, so wrong guidance there would reach customer repositories; the new statements I checked (bulkEncrypt is column-typed, bulkDecrypt/decrypt are bare delegations, bigint is native from the FFI, datePropertyPaths exists on the wasm entry) match the code at head. The changeset bumps stash and @cipherstash/stack as patches, and both are in a fixed group with @cipherstash/wizard, so the skill copy ships consistently. CI on the head commit passed all 15 checks, including the Node 22/24 test jobs that run the stack type tests. No material failure scenario found.

behaviour_changes.description: JSDoc on decrypt, bulkDecrypt and the table-less decryptModel overload (client-v3.ts) and on WasmEncryptionClient.decrypt / bulkDecrypt now states that date/timestamp columns come back as stored strings on the raw paths and corrects the reason (static typing, not missing column identity). Shipped in emitted .d.ts files; no signature changes.

Shipped agent skill skills/stash-encryption/SKILL.md and packages/stack/README.md gain a raw-path Date-vs-string warning and describe bulkEncrypt as column-typed rather than an untyped passthrough. The skill is copied into the stash and @cipherstash/wizard tarballs and from there into customer repositories.

New runtime tests pin decrypt/bulkDecrypt as bare delegations that return the stored string; new type tests pin the raw paths to JsPlaintext with no Date arm and the model paths to Date/string. Existing stubs are retyped from EncryptionClient to the factory's native-client parameter type; no existing assertion removed or weakened.
Adds a changeset bumping stash and @cipherstash/stack as patch; both are in a changesets fixed group with the other stack packages including @cipherstash/wizard.
